items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Yeah, Eddie Garland, that's my sister Anna, yeah, that was her boy.

ctx.x: Eddie Garland told me he used to go out with us, is that right?
Yeah, yeah, yeah, that was his old girlfriend. Yeah. Yeah, Eddie Garland, that's my sister Anna, yeah, that was her boy.
